newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones rose 30.01 points to 7,038.21. PLDT's ADR edged up $0 1/4 to $60 1/4.
* The peso closed 26.336 to a U.S. dollar from 26.340.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index jumped 24.41 points to 3,363.08.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average dipped 10.53125 percent from 10.5625.
*Philippine television station ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp said on Tuesday it has earmarked 500 million pesos in 1997 for its nationwide upgrading and expansion.

*The coupon rate on the Philippines' five-year fixed rate Treasury bonds plunged to 12.5 percent at an auction on Tuesday compared with 14.5 percent at the previous auction held in November last year, the Bureau of Treasury said.
* Philippine conglomerate JG Summit Holdings Inc plans to launch a $200 million seven-year Eurobond next week, syndicate managers said on Tuesday.
*Philippine Realty & Holdings Corp (Philrealty) said on Tuesday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with A Brown Co and two other groups to develop a 205.52 hectare property just outside Manila.
